## SQL workspace

- Run governed Spark SQL scripts in one Kyuubi session with per-statement results, persistent SQL history, and catalog, namespace, table, and view privileges.
- Use Catalyst planning and the Driver Guard to enforce identity-bound access. Table removal and physical purge have separate grants.
- Browse Iceberg tables and views in a resizable Polaris metadata tree. Use context menus to generate SQL and drag table names into the Monaco editor.
- Set query result TTL, history retention, and SQL audit retention in Helm. The object-storage plugin serves result pages read-only under its directory ACL. The gateway retries expired result cleanup in the background.

## Installation and upgrade

Use the dedicated Kyuubi chart to keep existing JDBC clients on their current instance. The chart is based on Apache Kyuubi 1.11.1 and includes the container args fix and a service account example.

The SQL gateway image contains the updated JAR at `/app/sql-guard.jar`. Update the Kyuubi image and Spark Driver together. See the deployment guides for extracting the JAR, updating `spark.jars`, and configuring the dedicated REST service.
